description:
In Elixir f(x) always names the function f/1. fz calls the variable instead: def run(value), do: value(value). interp: 'call_closure on non-closure value'; run/build exit 139 with no diagnostic (silent miscompile). json.erl's array_push has a parameter named value and calls value(...). Reproducer: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/punch/36_var_same_as_fn.fz

Part of fz-mue (fz runs OTP's json.erl unchanged). Port and harness: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/.

comments.text: PR #749 (stacked on #746). Commit 3747e2cb0: bare-name call resolves as the function; scope walk no longer counts it as a variable use. Fixtures 01781 (self oracle), 01782 (unused warning).

title: A call f(x) calls the function f even when a variable f is in scope
